563:t_025:44.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... You've been fighting alongside them all this time, haven't you.」

563:t_025:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes. They're my comrades, who share the same mission and burning hearts.」

563:t_025:46.en:
$n
(There are partings, and there are meetings... That's how the world keeps turning...)

563:t_027:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Dimensional boundary line distortion is rapidly increasing!」

563:t_027:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「This is...! It's the same type of pattern as the $$時空震動|lc$$ that occurred in $$第２新東京市$$!」

563:t_027:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Are we going to be thrown to the center of the galaxy again!?」

563:t_029:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't let your guard down. Have every unit hold position where it is until we're sure it's safe.」

563:t_030:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Annihilation of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ confirmed.」

563:t_030:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「But if this dimensional distortion stays fixed as it is...」

563:t_030:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then the $$宇宙怪獣$$ invasion of the Solar System would accelerate...」

563:t_031:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ are pulling back.」

563:t_031:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「But $$ランカ$$-chan and the others' song didn't reach them.」

563:t_031:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Don't give up after one or two tries! Keep singing until it reaches their hearts!」

563:t_031:3.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's what $$熱気バサラ$$ would say, I bet.」

563:t_031:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Listen to you, $$キャシー$$. It was like $$オズマ$$ possessed you.」

563:t_031:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Both $$ランカ・リー$$ and $$シェリル・ノーム$$ must know that.」

563:t_031:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「From here on, too, this ship will support their songs as far as it possibly can.」

563:t_100:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ニコラ$$'s impatience and frustration... It's the same as mine back in the $$一年戦争$$, when $$ブライト$$ nearly took me off the $$ガンダム$$...)

563:t_100:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Looking back now, I can laugh it off, but back then it felt like everything about me was being denied.)

563:t_100:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
(In the end, I lost $$リュウ$$... I don't want him to go through that same regret.)

563:t_101:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(If I could start over, what would I want to do...)

563:t_101:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Go back to my original world... Or go back even further, and $$綾波$$...)

563:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(If I could shape the world however I liked, what would I do...)

563:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Go back to before Dad died...? Go back to when I was with $$スミス$$...? Go back to when $$コーチ$$ was alive...?)

563:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(...I... want to see Big Sis... Not by starting over, but here in this very moment, I want to see Big Sis...)

563:t_103:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Even if they're tears of joy, don't shed tears on the battlefield, $$タカヤ$$!」

563:t_103:2.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's what he would say, without a doubt, $$ノリコ$$.」

563:t_103:4.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Let's cry our hearts out together, just the two of us. After we defeat that enemy.」

563:t_103:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Each of us alone is only a small fire, but put two together and we become a flame!」

563:t_103:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$, turned into a flame, is invincible! Please watch over us, $$コーチ$$!!」

563:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
(I believe that someday you'll come to understand humans...!)

563:t_104:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(But for now... all I can do is fight! $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$ are behind me!)

563:t_105:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
($$ニコラ$$... What was I... to $$ニコラ$$...)

563:t_105:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
(I'm... not a princess... I'm not $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis, either... I... the real me is...)

563:t_106:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Big Sis, so strong and kind and wonderful... $$ノノ$$ doesn't... know what to do...)

563:t_106:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(Big Sis, so strong and kind and wonderful... $$ノノ$$ doesn't... know what to do...)

563:t_106:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(Big Sis, so strong and kind and wonderful... $$ノノ$$ doesn't... know what to do...)

563:t_106:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
(At a time like this... what would $$ノノリリ$$ have done...)

563:t_106:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(At a time like this... what would $$ノノリリ$$ have done...)

563:t_106:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(At a time like this... what would $$ノノリリ$$ have done...)

563:t_107:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Every last one of them, with no idea how I feel...!)

563:t_107:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(That does it, I've had enough! If I'm going to lose the power of a $$トップレス$$ anyway, going out in a blaze of glory like a hero isn't a bad option!)

563:t_108:0.en:
$$チコ$$
(Ugh, come on! What are Princess, $$ノノ$$, and $$ニコラ$$ even doing!)

563:t_108:1.en:
$$チコ$$
(That does it, then. I'll just have to do my best on behalf of all the $$トップレス$$es!)

563:t_108:2.en:
$$チコ$$
(...Well... everyone's taken care of me all this time, so doing this once in a while isn't so bad...!)

563:t_109:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「With one unidentifiable enemy after another showing up like this, even if they're my ticket to paying off my debts, I'm sick of it...」

563:t_109:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(At this rate, I'm starting to dream of a world without debt...)

563:t_109:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Is what I'd like to say, but I'll pass on a world with nothing to strive for. If I did wish for a do-over...)

563:t_110:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(So this really is... the will of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...)

リュウ.evidence: Ryu Jose, Federation pilot and Amuro's mentor figure killed in the One Year War; Amuro says リュウさん (male). Not in glossary sheet.

タカヤ.evidence: Surname form of Noriko Takaya (タカヤ・ノリコ); Coach's line, quoted by Kazumi, addresses Noriko as Takaya (female).

kept_omissions: 563:t_031:1: Bobby's ランカちゃん達 kept as 'and the others' (達 not resolved to Sheryl).
563:t_026:2: Hibiki's 'あの穴…向こうから…' kept elliptical (verb/subject of what comes from the other side not stated).
uncertain: 563:t_026:2: 向こうから... literal; may mean Hibiki senses something (ELS will / pull) from beyond the hole.
563:t_103:1-2: Kazumi quotes Coach (あの人, male per glossary) addressing Noriko as Takaya; proposed token $$タカヤ$$ (Takaya).
563:t_100:2: リュウさん = Ryu (Jose), proposed token $$リュウ$$; not in glossary sheet.
563:t_102:1: パパ rendered 'Dad'; スミス token $$スミス$$ is the keyword entry (Smith), assumed to be Smith Toren.
563:t_109:0: 借金返済のネタ = 'my ticket to paying off my debts' (source of income).
563:t_031:6: Jeffrey line placed with pid CASSY; addressed to the room, 'それ' = the need to keep singing.
